claims.summary: The release is driven by a live EduTool.dev Astronomy package where worked examples appeared as legitimate supporting resources but the v0.15.11 grader marked them as prompt artifact contamination.
Prompt artifact detection allows worked examples as ordinary FAQ/supporting-resource phrasing while preserving numbered-topic detection.
The stricter P0 behavior remains intact for multi-label Course Map prompt artifact leakage.
Regression coverage now checks the astronomy worked-examples false-positive shape, environmental-science contamination, and instructional-design exemption together.
The release boundary keeps the CourseIR one-call architecture behind its existing live side-by-side proof gates while this patch tunes the shipped grader.

carryForward.next: Run deployed side-by-side 5-, 8-, and 15-lesson CourseIR comparisons before making CourseIR generation the default.
